title: [Lean] Verification of selected 1320-port bijection, κ=0.000661885549259598
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Publish one completed, reusable Lean 4.21.0 chunk in research/lean-selected-port-bijection. This is 74 local Lean modules plus reproducibility and source-provenance files, with no Mathlib dependency and no changes to inherited root files or scientific checks.

Finite coverage: exact ordered selected1320 inputMask labels equal PairedCubeSourceLabels.labels 11; actual inverseTable provides both inverse laws; whole-row and two-bank gather/scatter are inverse reindexings preserving arbitrary helper/spectator values. Generic bijection laws are not claimed as new mathematics.

Conditional-interface coverage: this supplies a concrete selected port interface for subsequent construction work. It does not supply the physical invocation provider, shared-helper three-stage implementation, dirty frame equation, or cost bound. Full multiplication/runtime theorem coverage: not established by this chunk.

Explicit author-checked retained source kappa: 330942774629799/500000000000000000 = 0.000661885549259598, from source commit 3b6b66891c0ac888521cf591fe306c6286601d4f. AUTHOR_CHECK.json and PROVENANCE.json record the statement/source check and retained attribution. This conditional parameter is not proved as an exponent theorem here.

Base at submission: 12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b; head: 15b49f66cb2d2663fb71672f4d594e755bd93938. The newer base README parameter 0.000723571590007464 is a separate target; equality of changed selected data is not asserted.

Predecessors and reuse: retained selected supplier attribution and notice are included. This chunk adds the exact accessor/table binding; it does not recopy the generic chain or physical-provider work in #397/#430, or the separately developed input-preparation work. Current PR searches for 1320 and bijection were compared before submission; no matching completed exact-table Lean chunk was identified. Substantial OpenAI model assistance was used.

## Validation

Fresh isolated replay on Linux, official Lean 4.21.0: all 74 modules PASS, with source hashes/import order checked and no old objects or Mathlib paths. Total compiler time 142.881 s; FIFO wait 370.106 s; maximum module time 8.5875 s; peak process virtual memory 3,272,663,040 bytes. All 74 object hashes and 153 axiom sets match the source-matched historical receipts. Independent package and terminal-replay reviews completed. See REPLAY_SUMMARY.json.

Reproduce from the package directory: python3 check.py --lean /path/to/lean-4.21.0/bin/lean --build-dir .build

The runner uses 60-second/4-GiB hard bounds and stops for review above 45 seconds/3.5 GiB. This local Lean kernel replay is separate from executable scientific tests, exact-head fork CI, upstream CI and maintainer approval. No new CI pass is claimed here. make verify and make gen4-bank-verify were not run as part of this isolated additive chunk.

Draft for review of the completed finite component; no frontier improvement or full-theorem claim.
